quote: Experiments on this dataset demonstrate that statistical learning approaches effectively model language production in acquisition. Our Expectation Maximization (EM; grammar induction achieves parsing accuracy (0.952) comparable to an oracle with perfect grammatical knowledge (0.948), with simi-lar trends in generation quality (0.777 vs 0.688 in BLEU score).
BLEU is computed against original child utterances to evaluate how well the induced grammar can produce utterances from a given meaning.
